step.mountain.hermit.name: Survey the Mountain Route
step.mountain.hermit.description: Talk to Clint, then bring Robin hardwood, copper, and iron to reopen the old mining path.
dialogue.mountain.hermit.clint: I can't tunnel a minecart line through the mountain on my own. Talk to Robin at the carpenter shop; she knows the old passages.
dialogue.mountain.hermit.robin: Clint sent you? Good. I'll start the survey and shore up the old mine path. Hand over the timber and ingots when you're ready.
npc.flow.next: {{npc}} wants to see you about the {{spot}} route.
step.mountain.rebuild.name: Rebuild the Mountain Line
step.mountain.rebuild.description: Lay new rails with iron and gold ingots.
step.mountain.test.name: Final Test Run
step.mountain.test.description: Prove the line with iridium and prismatic shards.
step.desert.survey.name: Survey the Desert Route
step.desert.survey.description: Survey the route and lay the first rails with gold and cactus fruit.
step.desert.tracks.name: Lay the Desert Tracks
step.desert.tracks.description: Extend the line with gold, iridium, and a coconut water cache.
step.desert.inspection.name: Final Desert Inspection
step.desert.inspection.description: Finish the line with gold, iridium, cactus fruit, and prismatic shards.
step.ginger.chart.name: Chart the Island Route
step.ginger.chart.description: Chart a safe landing with gold, iridium, and ginger.
step.ginger.volcano.name: Forge Volcano-Grade Rails
step.ginger.volcano.description: Forge rails that survive the volcano with cinder shards and dragon teeth.
step.ginger.install.name: Install the Island Link
step.ginger.install.description: Calibrate the link with gold, iridium, cinder, batteries, prismatic shards, and magma caps.
difficulty.easy.name: Easy
difficulty.easy.description: Half unlock costs, no ride fare, and no discovery requirement.
difficulty.hard.name: Hard
difficulty.hard.description: Double unlock costs and resources, higher ride fares, and discovery required.
difficulty.realistic.name: Realistic
difficulty.realistic.description: Base costs and fares, with discovery required.
